<op(36,1)><sp(2)>The #c[BE5050]Jovian fleet#c is <im(1)>converging on the ruins

<op(36,1)><sp(2)>We will <im(2)>#c[F07141]eliminate the enemy <im(8)>fleet#c

rows.jp:

<op(36,1)><sp(2)>Letting the #c[BE5050]enemy fleet#c escape hurts later.
